title: Revolut hit by data breach after fake government email scam
text: Revolut has confirmed that it disclosed sensitive customer information, including passports, after receiving fraudulent requests sent from a legitimate government agency email domain.

title: Saudi fintech Tabby raises $233m
text: Tabby, a Saudi-based fintech, has seen its valuation rise to $6.5bn after completing its latest funding round.

title: Pave raises $15m for AI-powered portfolio management platform
text: AI-powered portfolio management platform for financial advisors Pave Finance has raised over $15 million at a $100 million pre-money valuation in an oversubscribed Series A round.

title: Bank of Ireland and Stripe strike digital transformation deal
text: Bank of Ireland (BoI) has announced a partnership with Irish payments fintech Stripe that the bank has described as a "key milestone" in its digital transformation programme.

title: Singapore banks complete blockchain-enabled SGD transactions on Swift ledger
text: DBS, OCBC and UOB have completed live domestic Singapore dollar transactions using tokenised deposits on Swift’s blockchain-based ledger.
